title: What's on for kids in Dublin this November
note: Days: 0=Sun … 6=Sat. start/end are minutes after midnight; null means times vary (parent adds their own ticket time, or it goes in as all day).

events.title: The Dead Zoo Lab
events.venue: National Museum of Ireland, Collins Barracks
events.desc: The Natural History Museum's animals in their temporary home. Free, dry and fascinating.

events.title: Sunday family drop-ins, National Gallery
events.venue: National Gallery of Ireland, Merrion Square
events.desc: Rock up, grab the materials and make something. No booking.

events.title: Hilma af Klint: Artist and Visionary
events.desc: Huge, colourful abstract paintings. Good for big kids who like patterns and shapes.

events.title: Children's storytime, Cabra Library
events.desc: A weekly after-school story session at the library.

events.title: Babies @ The Ark: Excitedly Resting
events.desc: A soft, sensory textile space for babies. Wed and Fri mornings are for under-8-months only. No booking.

events.title: Dublin Book Festival family day
events.venue: Royal Irish Academy of Music, Westland Row
events.desc: Treasure hunt, craft station and a children's book swap. Bring a book they've outgrown.

events.title: Peng and Spanners: Dr Biscuits!
events.desc: Comic author Steve Webb draws live and finishes with bingo. Tickets go fast.

events.title: North Dublin Science Festival
events.venue: DCU, The Helix, Deaf Village Ireland
events.desc: Free water-themed science all week, including STEM in Irish Sign Language (9–13 Nov).

events.title: Wild Lights, Dublin Zoo
events.desc: Giant lanterns across 9 zones. Last entry 7:30pm. Sensory-friendly night Tue 1 Dec.

events.title: Wonderlights, Malahide Castle
events.desc: An illuminated trail through the castle grounds. Go early in the run for quieter nights.

events.title: The Dublin Double: EPIC + Wild Lights
events.desc: Interactive museum by day, lanterns at the zoo after dark. One combined ticket.
events.times: Museum by day, zoo by night

events.title: Elf Town Dublin
events.desc: A 90-minute Christmas journey (from €29 per child) ending with a private chat with Santa.

events.title: The Helix Panto: Neverland
events.desc: Peter Pan, panto-style, on the northside. Earlier dates are easier for good seats.

events.title: TwinkleTown Smithfield
events.desc: Big wheel, funfair, ice skating and a weekend Santo Panto. Sensory skating from Sat 28 Nov at 11am.

events.title: Robin Hood: The Gaiety Panto
events.desc: The big city-centre panto. Flashing lights, loud bangs, smoke and pyro.

events.title: A Christmas Carol, The Ark
events.desc: A 45-minute Scrooge made for children. Relaxed and ISL performances in December.

events.title: Early Years Workshop: All The Red Things
events.desc: Toddlers and their grown-up make a little fabric book about the colour red.

events.title: TwinkleTown St Patrick's Park
events.desc: Carousels, a lit-up park walk and carol singers beside the cathedral.

events.title: Swords Castle Christmas Market
events.desc: A castle-courtyard Christmas market. Hours are provisional, so check before you go.

events.title: A Christmas to Remember, Newbridge House
events.desc: Hot chocolate, Mrs Claus, a farmyard walk and a fireside visit with Santa.

events.title: Santa at Malahide Castle
events.desc: Meet Santa at the castle. Weekends nearest Christmas go first.

events.title: Quiet Hour at the museum
events.venue: National Museum of Ireland, Collins Barracks
events.desc: Lights softened and sounds down for an hour, for kids who find crowds a lot. November date to be confirmed.

events.title: Christmas walking trails, Marlay Park
events.desc: A calm, buggy-friendly lit-up walk. Dates to be announced.
